## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible change.

## Verification

List the commands, platforms, devices, or fixtures used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Public API changes include documentation and tests.
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated rather than edited by hand.
- [ ] Required test suites ran without skips.
- [ ] No credentials, model files, local paths, or temporary artifacts are included.
- [ ] Packaging or release changes preserve provenance and checksum checks.
